clusters.title: Core System Stability Fixes and Platform Enhancements
clusters.summary: Users are requesting critical bug fixes for task lifecycle management, race conditions, and provider parsing to ensure consistent reliability across environments. They also require expanded channel integrations, advanced configuration inheritance, and improved media handling to streamline cross-platform workflows and system interoperability.
clusters.representative_need: Add Chinese (Simplified) localization support to the Android app
sample_titles: Add Chinese (Simplified) localization support to the Android app
Add DingTalk channel support
Ensure subagent runTimeoutSeconds enforces hard termination instead of triggering model fallback retry

clusters.title: Fix Telegram DM Command Approval and File Context Handling
clusters.summary: Users are reporting bugs where command execution approval workflows are inconsistently triggered or bypassed in Telegram direct messages. They also need reliable attachment of Telegram file messages to the active session context. These fixes are essential to maintain secure command execution and accurate conversation state during Telegram interactions.
clusters.representative_need: Fix attachment of Telegram file messages to session context
sample_titles: Fix attachment of Telegram file messages to session context
Fix command execution approval triggering in Telegram DM mode
Fix exec command approval bypass in Telegram DM mode

clusters.title: Resolve UI Overflows and Streaming Text Parsing Errors
clusters.summary: Users are requesting fixes for interface layout glitches and multi-byte character handling that disrupt command prompts and streaming outputs. These enhancements will ensure a polished visual experience and prevent text corruption during interactive sessions.
clusters.representative_need: Fix command permission dialog UI overflow and add setting to disable approval prompts
sample_titles: Fix command permission dialog UI overflow and add setting to disable approval prompts
Handle multi-byte UTF-8 character boundaries correctly during streaming response parsing

clusters.title: Fix cron job execution, delivery, and reporting failures
clusters.summary: Users are encountering multiple failures with scheduled cron jobs, including problems waking agent sessions, delivering messages during active sessions, and reporting errors when environment variables are used. Addressing these issues is critical to ensure consistent automated task execution and accurate error notifications for agent workflows.
clusters.representative_need: Fix cron job failure reporting when using environment variables for delivery channels
sample_titles: Fix cron job failure reporting when using environment variables for delivery channels
Fix cron job message delivery failure when ACP sessions are active
Fix cron jobs failing to wake agent sessions

clusters.title: Robust Session State Persistence and Context Continuity
clusters.summary: Users need reliable session management to prevent conversation context loss during automatic compaction or channel switches. They also require accurate state persistence to ensure runs correctly transition to terminal states. These improvements are essential for maintaining seamless conversational continuity and preventing silent session failures.
clusters.representative_need: Fix conversation context loss and silent session abandonment after automatic compaction
sample_titles: Fix conversation context loss and silent session abandonment after automatic compaction
Fix session store status persistence to correctly transition completed runs to a terminal state
Support session reuse and context sharing across communication channels

clusters.title: Fix Plugin Dependency Installation and Registration Conflicts
clusters.summary: Users want the system to automatically install or bundle plugin peer dependencies during upgrades to prevent missing functionality. They also need to resolve issues where duplicate plugin loads incorrectly skip tool registration. Fixing these problems will ensure a stable plugin ecosystem and reliable upgrade experiences.
clusters.representative_need: Fix automatic installation or bundling of plugin peer dependencies during upgrades
sample_titles: Fix automatic installation or bundling of plugin peer dependencies during upgrades
Fix plugin tool registration skipping during duplicate plugin loads

clusters.title: Improve Inbound Message Filtering and Plugin Hook Reliability
clusters.summary: Users are requesting better filtering of non-essential inbound events, such as iMessage tapbacks, to prevent processing noise and errors. They also need consistent triggering of plugin execution hooks during embedded agent runs to guarantee reliable automation workflows. These changes will clean up message ingestion and ensure dependable plugin behavior across different runtime contexts.
clusters.representative_need: Ensure plugin tool execution hooks trigger consistently in embedded agent runs
sample_titles: Ensure plugin tool execution hooks trigger consistently in embedded agent runs
Filter iMessage tapback reactions from inbound message processing

clusters.title: Resolve agent authentication and messaging delivery issues
clusters.summary: Users need fixes for authentication failures when spawning subagents on unsupported channels, alongside corrections to prevent duplicate and stale responses in the messaging gateway. Addressing these bugs is essential for ensuring consistent and accurate communication across the system.
clusters.representative_need: Fix duplicate and stale response delivery in the messaging gateway
sample_titles: Fix duplicate and stale response delivery in the messaging gateway
Fix subagent spawning authentication requirement for channels lacking pairing support

clusters.title: Granular Configuration Options for AI Reasoning and System Settings
clusters.summary: Users want more flexible and granular control over how AI reasoning and underlying system processes are configured. They are specifically requesting scoped settings, secure environment variable resolution, customizable output languages, and adjustable processing timeouts. These enhancements will allow teams to better align the platform with their specific security policies, workflow requirements, and performance expectations.
clusters.representative_need: Support configurable language for AI reasoning output
sample_titles: Support configurable language for AI reasoning output
Support configurable timeout for LLM prompt processing
Support environment variable resolution for sensitive configuration fields

clusters.title: Fix Authentication Header and OAuth Scope Regressions
clusters.summary: Users are reporting recent regressions where OAuth authentication headers are incorrectly routed and operator scopes are unexpectedly cleared for shared-auth API clients. These issues disrupt secure API access and token validation, requiring immediate fixes to restore reliable authentication workflows.
clusters.representative_need: Fix Anthropic OAuth token authentication header routing regression
sample_titles: Fix Anthropic OAuth token authentication header routing regression
Fix regression that clears operator scopes for shared-auth API clients

clusters.title: Improve Session Lock Handling and Workflow Orchestration
clusters.summary: Users want the system to automatically reclaim file locks left behind by terminated processes, while also enabling the creation of named, reusable procedural workflows. These enhancements will eliminate resource contention and provide developers with a standardized way to automate complex, multi-step tasks.
clusters.representative_need: Add support for named, reusable procedural workflows via a ROUTINE.md specification
sample_titles: Add support for named, reusable procedural workflows via a ROUTINE.md specification
Fix stale session file lock reclamation when holder process exits

clusters.title: Enhance Discord Thread Customization and Voice Channel Reliability
clusters.summary: Users want customizable prompts for auto-generated Discord thread titles to improve organization and personalization. They also need a fix for voice channels failing to capture incoming audio to ensure stable communication. Addressing these requests will significantly improve the reliability and usability of Discord integrations.
clusters.representative_need: Fix Discord voice channel failing to capture incoming user audio
sample_titles: Fix Discord voice channel failing to capture incoming user audio
Support customizable prompts for auto-generated Discord thread titles
